verdict.rationale: Vue's docs and ecosystem support component-based, modular architecture (components, official Pinia store, Vue Router) which enables building reusable building blocks, and community praises separation of concerns (vue-comm-8, vue-comm-9, vue-comm-13). However, no evidence explicitly documents Vue's provide/inject dependency-injection API or composables pattern, and one community comment even flags that global store (Vuex) usage can break modularity (vue-comm-19). missing for 10: explicit documentation of provide/inject or composable-based dependency injection, first-party examples of DI patterns, independent corroboration of modular DI usage.
